criteria.requirement: Add Command.describe(ctx) returning an independent info dictionary with all existing to_info_dict fields plus usage=self.get_usage(ctx) and command_path=ctx.command_path. Require ctx.command is self. Respect actual parent/group invocation names, custom usage/formatter settings and subclass metadata overrides, without invoking command callbacks, parsing values or changing the original to_info_dict schema. Work for groups, aliases and nested commands; metadata remains Python data with existing value types rather than claiming arbitrary values are JSON serializable.
Deliver the authorized source changes, public regression tests that fail on the original version, and English compatibility documentation. All frozen native regression tests must pass.

comparison: Accept equivalent implementations according to actual program behavior; do not grade by matching reference text or its length.
